tokens.name: bg-000
tokens.usage: App frame behind everything: the sidebar and the scrim around modals. The darkest step; nothing sits below it.

tokens.name: bg-100
tokens.usage: Main canvas: conversation, detail pages, the right panel. Default page background.

tokens.name: bg-200
tokens.usage: Raised surfaces: cards, modals, popovers, option tiles. One step above the canvas — never stack two bg-200s.

tokens.name: bg-300
tokens.usage: Selected or hovered row: active nav item, selected list row, hovered card.

tokens.name: bg-400
tokens.usage: Fields: inputs, search, the composer. Also the hairline color — see `border`.

tokens.name: bg-500
tokens.usage: Secondary button and neutral chip fill (Adjust plan, Add, Update).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards and panels (1px). Decorative only: controls are told apart by fill, not by this line.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Hairline on raised surfaces that sit on bg-200 (modal header rule, input outline on a modal).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons: titles, body, values. 15.3:1 on bg-100, 9.7:1 on bg-500.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: descriptions, metadata, timestamps, inactive tabs. ≥4.5:1 on bg-000 through bg-400.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary text: placeholders, section labels (UP NEXT, FINISHED), disclaimers. ≥4.5:1 on bg-000, bg-100, bg-200 only — never on bg-300 or deeper fills.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ninjy gold/amber — the logo's gold ring, and the one action color: primary button fill, links, active tab underline, inline code, selected chip text, focus ring. Text on bg-000…bg-500 passes (≥6.2:1).

tokens.name: brand-gold
tokens.usage: Brand gold — the second ring of the Ninjy mark, and the source of `accent`. Reference it as `accent` in UI; use `brand-gold` directly only for the logo, the cover and marketing. 9.7:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: brand-teal
tokens.usage: Brand teal — the alternate second ring (light app icon). Identity only: the logo and marketing, never in UI controls or status. 8.3:1 on bg-100.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and the dark ring on a `brand-gold` or `brand-teal` fill; also the mark's dark ring on light grounds.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an `accent` or `success` fill (10.9:1 on accent). Never white on gold.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet accent ground: selected filter chip, info tile icon well, 'Default' badge fill. Pair with `accent` text.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done, linked, online: status dots, Done badges, progress fill, 'All clear'. Always beside a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for Done/Linked badges and the success icon well. Pair with `success` text.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Live and in-flight: running counts, instances, previews in the status bar. Text on bg-000…bg-400 passes.

tokens.name: info-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for running/in-progress badges. Pair with `info` text.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention but not broken: retry pending, attempts nearly used, plan limits. A redder orange than `accent` so the two stay apart; always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for warning badges. Pair with `warning` text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed runs, destructive actions (text or outline, never a big fill). Differs from `success` mainly by hue, so it always carries a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground for failed/error badges and destructive confirm rows. Pair with `danger` text.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset, on every interactive element. ≥6.2:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and command palettes (search, settings).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Text role="display": the page's single h1 (PageShell title) and empty-state headlines.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Text role="heading": section headings, Panel and Modal titles, the selected item's name in a detail pane.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Both merged and pushed to main. Tested on the merged tree before pushing.
styles.usage: Agent replies and long markdown prose in the conversation column. Max line length 72ch. (Not a Text role yet: apply to the chat markdown container.)

styles.name: title
styles.sample: P2: installer and updater place ham-ctl
styles.usage: Text role="title": card, ticket and row titles; Alert and Toast titles.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Deployment config of downstar and VPS
styles.usage: Text role="body": default UI text, form values, menu items, md buttons.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Text role="body-sm": metadata lines, descriptions, hints, sm buttons.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Text role="label": form labels, Badge and StatusPill text, counts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Text role="caption": timestamps, status-bar items, Kbd.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Text role="overline": uppercase section labels and the PageShell eyebrow. Always uppercase, always ink-subtle.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Text role="code": inline code, paths, branch names, commands.

styles.name: code-sm
styles.usage: IDs, hashes and slugs under a title. (Not a Text role yet: role="code" + caption size.)

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap inside chips; dot-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between inline controls; icon-to-label in buttons and nav items; nav item vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button and input horizontal padding; gap between stacked rows inside a card.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding; row vertical padding in data lists; page gutter on mobile.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between cards and between sections inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop; space above a page title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Separation between major page regions; empty-state padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, inline code, icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, list rows, tabs.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, option tiles, icon wells, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Modals, the composer, large panels.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status dots, avatars, progress bars, pill toggles.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and the command palette — anything floating over content.

tokens.name: shadow-modal
tokens.usage: Modals (Settings) over the scrim. Cards never carry a shadow: they use `border`.
